name: Joint Optimization of NeRF and Camera Parameters
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields Without Known Camera Parameters
definition: A method that jointly optimizes a NeRF model and camera parameters (poses and focal length) for forward-facing images, simplifying classical two-stage Novel View Synthesis (NVS) systems by eliminating the need for pre-computed camera poses.
summary: Joint Optimization of NeRF and Camera Parameters simultaneously learns neural radiance fields and camera poses from images, eliminating the need for pre-computed Structure-from-Motion.
